notes: Reviews are now per-language: each review has a Language field (Reviews section), and GET /api/reviews takes a ?lang= parameter (e.g. ?lang=en) returning only that language's approved reviews in their manual order - falls back to the site's default language automatically when a language has no reviews yet, so the homepage never shows an empty section while you're still building out translations. Existing reviews were tagged Persian. Requires 'Update database' (adds a lang column to reviews).
